name: SKP Bearing Industries Ltd.
summary: SKP Bearing Industries Ltd. manufactures and supplies precision rolling elements, including needle rollers, cylindrical rollers, pins, and steel balls. These components are critical for various industries, such as the automotive, textile, cosmetics, medical device, pharmaceutical, and broader industrial sectors. The company serves both domestic and international markets, supplying to reputable bearing manufacturers and original equipment manufacturers (OEMs). In addition to its manufacturing operations, SKP Bearing Industries Ltd. is also involved in power generation through windmill and solar power projects. The company emphasizes quality, with products finding applications in areas where high load capacity and precision are essential. They have an internal laboratory for product validation and testing and are expanding their manufacturing capabilities.
